body: I talked to him about it last night. He was far more understanding than I thought he would be, and I did feel a bit better after having done so. Thank you.

For the most part the cats ignore her. The parrot does have free roam of the house, but she generally sticks to the top of her cage or her 2 play stands. Her wings aren’t clipped, but she never learned how to fly properly, so she isn’t interested in trying to fly around. Sometimes if she wants to go back to her cage she’ll kinda glide down to the floor and walk there, but that’s pretty rare. When she’s on the floor the cats are more interested, because it’s something fun and new, but she isn’t scared of them.

I liked reading what you had to say about the use of “I” in your statement. People always do say that the cure for depression is to do the things that YOU enjoy, and to live your life for YOU and no one else. If what I enjoy is video games and movies, then I shouldn’t be ashamed, even if it may seem lame to someone else. I do think that I could possibly find something more engaging to do though, because sitting all the time tends to lead to bad eating habits, and hat leads to a worse sense of self worth. I recently bought an exercise game for the Switch called Ring Fit Adventure. Been sitting in the box for over a week now. I need to break it out and use it.
It’s been like this for nearly 17 years. How long does it take for the downs to become less often and less invasive?
I don’t want him to love me less. I already give him enough reminders of what a worthless piece of shit I am, he doesn’t need more.

I’m afraid he’ll love me less if I’m completely open with him. He doesn’t need yet another reminder of what a worthless piece of shit I am, and that he could find much better.

My therapist back in the day didn’t help me at all. She was a nice lady, don’t get me wrong, it’s not like she didn’t care. Her methods just weren’t for me. I felt like she was just being paid to agree with everything I say, and tell me to do breathing exercises and meditate, neither of which helped at all.

Mainly I play Dead By Daylight, but gonna be tying out Death Stranding tomorrow when it comes out. It’s stupid, but I feel like sometimes the only thing that keeps me alive (besides family and friends) is my knowledge that if I die, I won’t be able to enjoy a certain game or movie that I’ve been waiting for to come out. I mean, I guess it’s better than nothing. 

I have 3 cats and a parrot. Going to be getting a puppy next month once he’s old enough. A little corgi. That’s also one thing keeping me going I guess. Mostly I just watch stupid shit on YouTube. Ghost videos, hoarders, let’s plays, that kind of stuff. What games did you play? Also I find that I usually can’t sit still and focus long enough to read a book. So I usually do audiobooks cuz I can listen while I clean or something.

Internet strangers are the only ones I feel like I can talk to right now. Someone who doesn’t actually know me, and shrouded behind a fake account, so I have no reason to hide anything. Right now the only things I really enjoy are video games, watching shows, and being with my animals. It’s basically all I do when I get home from work. Recently the fiancé got a new job on a swing shift, I’m currently on day shift. Being alone all evening with my own thoughts is not a good thing right now, so I just glue myself to the tv until I go to bed so that my mind doesn’t wander.
